planks.name: Cost
planks.purpose: What this takes to do, and where the money comes from.
planks.why: A decision without a funded cost is a wish, not a motion.

outcomes.poor: Costs blow out; the group is left out of pocket or the project stalls unfunded.
outcomes.expected: Delivered roughly on budget from the source planned for it.
outcomes.good: Delivered on budget, funded cleanly, no strain on reserves.
outcomes.exceptional: Delivered under budget, or funded in a way that leaves the group better resourced than before.

planks.name: Labour
planks.why: Work assigned to nobody doesn't happen.

outcomes.poor: The work falls on no one, or on one person who burns out; it doesn't get done, or gets done badly.
outcomes.expected: The work gets done by those who took it on.
outcomes.good: Done well, shared fairly across those involved.
outcomes.exceptional: Done, and it builds capability — more people able to do it next time.

planks.name: Review
planks.purpose: When the community looks at this again.
planks.why: Decisions that never get revisited fossilise in the minutes.

outcomes.poor: It's never looked at again; problems compound unnoticed.
outcomes.expected: Reviewed at the set point and adjusted if needed.
outcomes.good: Review confirms it's working, or catches a problem early enough to fix cheaply.
outcomes.exceptional: Review becomes a rhythm — the decision stays live and keeps improving.
